title: Priority Pointer Width Mismatch (8 Masters)
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [STARVE] Masters 4-7 never granted; last_gnt truncated to 2 bits
rtl: logic [1:0] last_gnt;  // Only 4 states — 8-master design needs 3 bits
expected_root_cause: The priority pointer last_gnt is declared as logic [1:0] (4 states) in an 8-master design that requires 3 bits (8 states); masters 4–7 are permanently unreachable by the pointer.
fix_replacement:
localparam PTR_W = $clog2(NUM_MASTERS);
logic [PTR_W-1:0] last_gnt;  // Correct width for any NUM_MASTERS
description: The priority pointer is declared as 2 bits but the design has 8 masters requiring 3 bits; the pointer silently truncates to 4 states, permanently starving masters 4–7.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [STARVE] Masters 4-7 never granted; last_gnt truncated to 2 bits
success_log: All 8 masters receive grants. last_gnt cycles 0–7 correctly.
